# K10 offline contract fixtures

These are **synthetic, minimal official-reference-style excerpts**, not downloaded
documentation or assertions that these URLs exist. Version labels scope each
test's inputs; tests inject matching authority records explicitly. They exercise
supported grammar, unknown defaults, command hierarchy and version isolation.
No test executes pytest/Ruff/Next/.NET or accesses a registry/network.

Real-reference corpus validation remains a K19/release-review task.
